description: Source code implementing Vulkan-specific tensor mean operations for the PyTorch library, including functions for computing mean over specified dimensions with Vulkan backend support.

methods.name: mean_dim
methods.description: Computes the mean of a tensor along a specified dimension using Vulkan backend, supporting keepdim and dtype options.

methods.name: mean_dim_IntList
methods.description: Computes the mean over multiple dimensions specified in an optional list, utilizing Vulkan backend.
